Dissolved, not fixed: refinery moved to truncating rejected inputs to their first 1 MiB instead of dropping them over the 1 MiB cap. Every exit-1 run now has a file, so ListFailedRuns no longer needs os.Stat to decide whether path is present, and there is no remaining case where 'not kept' and 'deleted' need to be told apart on a plain listing. Full digest / truncated content also gives a free tamper-vs-truncation signal (hash the file, compare to its name) with no new column. See internal/store/files.go WriteRejected, internal/store/read.go ListFailedRuns, and docs/config.md §4.4, §4.4.1, §6.1, §6.3, §4.7.
